sigshape — signature shapes

From sigs.tsv by scripts/build_sigshape.nu: each fn's as-written signature decomposed into a few structural facts — the receiver, whether it threads Io, whether it's generic — so std's API ergonomics become groupable.

@@SIG_IO@@

By first parameter

the receiver shape — self (a method), allocator (allocating), none (niladic), or other (a free function over its args)

@@SIG_FP_BARS@@

Signature traits

cross-cutting facts, each a share of all @@N_SIGSHAPE@@ functions — a signature can carry several at once

By module
